# Eyakub Sorkar

Full-stack engineer in Dhaka. I build the parts of a business that can't break: orders, payments, deliveries, compliance. Python, Django, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Next.js.

## Experience

- SDS Manager, Software Engineer (July 2025 – Present): ExactSDS: AI features behind FastAPI for chemical-safety compliance. Hub One: Stride, an agent-assisted task board in development.
- Goama, Full-stack Developer (May 2022 – August 2025): Django/DRF for high-traffic apps, payments in Latin America (+20% reach), unit tests (−30% bugs), CI/CD to Kubernetes.
- Aadi BD Ltd., Software Engineer (June 2020 – April 2022): Cross-border e-commerce, a local delivery system (+40% logistics efficiency), Redx, Pathao, DHL and UPS integrations.
- Venture Solutions Ltd., Jr. Software Engineer (May 2019 – March 2020): Booking app for convention halls, internal CRM, payment gateway integration.
- Tryonyx (now The Prestige Global), Internship (Feb 2019 – May 2019): Python, Django and Flutter foundations.

## Projects

- [ExactSDS](https://exactsds.sdsmanager.com/): AI-powered safety data sheet creation: several models, retrieval over historical safety data and rule-based hazard classification, built on close study of GHS, CLP, REACH and OSHA.
- [Razlio AI](https://app.razlio.com/): An AI sales agent that chats with customers in Bengali and English on Messenger, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and the web, sells from the live catalogue and takes the order.
- [Razlio Commerce](https://razlio.com/commerce/): A storefront on your own domain, cash on delivery and bKash or Nagad with transaction-ID checks, five couriers booked from the order, and a P&L that counts costs. Our own shop, Razlio Mart, runs on it.
- [Hub One · Stride](https://eyakub.github.io/projects): An agent-assisted task board inside Hub One, SDS Manager's internal platform. In development for internal use, launching soon.
- [Rallo](https://github.com/Eyakub/Rallo): A macOS desktop pet that keeps notes in view and waves when Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI is waiting on you. Built in Rust and Swift.
- [Go Games](https://go-games.gg/tournament?app=goama&country=SG): Tournaments and mini-games that companies plug into their apps. Payments expanded reach in Latin America by 20%, and unit testing cut bugs by 30%.
- [Aadi BD](https://eyakub.github.io/projects): Bangladesh's first cross-border marketplace, with a local delivery system (+40% logistics efficiency) and Redx, Pathao, DHL and UPS integrations.
- [Moiur](https://eyakub.github.io/projects): Booking for convention halls and party centres, with catering, an internal CRM and a payment gateway.
